name: Walmart Marketplace
label: Walmart Marketplace US v3 — orders, items, inventory
description: US Marketplace host marketplace.walmartapis.com/v3. Header WM_SEC.ACCESS_TOKEN (not Authorization Bearer; refresh out of band). extraHeaders send required WM_QOS.CORRELATION_ID, WM_SVC.NAME, and optional WM_CONSUMER.CHANNEL.TYPE from config/input. CA/MX hosts differ. Acknowledge within 4 hours. Never log buyer email. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (trigger) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event). Docs: https://developer.walmart.com/us-marketplace/docs/lag-time-api-overview
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One official API operation. Secrets stay in configurationParameters.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official API verb. EXACT: order_list | order_ack | item_get | inventory_update | trigger. Blank uses configurationParameters.operation. trigger (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port).

schema.label: correlation_id
schema.description: WM_QOS.CORRELATION_ID. Prefer a new GUID per request. Overrides config correlation_id. Omitted when blank (Walmart may 400).

schema.label: purchaseOrderId
schema.description: URL path parameter `purchaseOrderId` for operation: order_ack. Required by: order_ack.

schema.label: sku
schema.description: Seller SKU. Path/query for item_get and inventory_update (required query). Also sent in the inventory_update body. Encode special characters. Example: SKU_0001.

schema.label: shipNode
schema.description: Fulfillment ship node for inventory_update (query). Omit to use the default node.

schema.label: amount
schema.description: Inventory count for inventory_update. Nested as quantity.amount. Example: 10. https://developer.walmart.com/us-marketplace/docs/update-single-item-inventory

schema.label: unit
schema.description: Inventory unit for inventory_update. Official value: EACH. Nested as quantity.unit. Default EACH.

schema.label: inventoryAvailableDate
schema.description: US inventory available date YYYY-MM-DD for inventory_update. Example: 2026-01-15.

schema.label: nextCursor
schema.description: order_list pagination cursor from the previous response.

ports.name: output
ports.description: status=ok + data on 2xx. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Secrets never present. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status. Never includes secrets.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. May contain order PII — do not log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb for OfficialApiNode. EXACT: order_list | order_ack | item_get | inventory_update | trigger. Selecting trigger (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: WM_SEC.ACCESS_TOKEN. OAuth access token minted outside StudioQuack (Client ID/Secret → POST /v3/token). Never INPUT, never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Channel Type
configurationParameters.description: WM_CONSUMER.CHANNEL.TYPE as documented for the seller. Sent as extraHeader when set; omitted when blank.

configurationParameters.label: Correlation Id
configurationParameters.description: WM_QOS.CORRELATION_ID. Official requires a unique GUID per request. Set on INPUT for each call (or here as a fallback). Header omitted if blank.

configurationParameters.label: Svc Name
configurationParameters.description: WM_SVC.NAME. Official required header. Default Walmart Marketplace.

configurationParameters.label: Nextcursor
configurationParameters.description: order_list pagination cursor from the previous response.

configurationParameters.label: Purchaseorderid
configurationParameters.description: URL path parameter `purchaseOrderId` for operation: order_ack. Required by: order_ack.

configurationParameters.label: Sku
configurationParameters.description: Seller SKU. Path/query for item_get and inventory_update (required query). Also sent in the inventory_update body. Encode special characters. Example: SKU_0001.

configurationParameters.label: Shipnode
configurationParameters.description: Fulfillment ship node for inventory_update (query). Omit to use the default node.

configurationParameters.label: Amount
configurationParameters.description: Inventory count for inventory_update. Nested as quantity.amount. Example: 10. https://developer.walmart.com/us-marketplace/docs/update-single-item-inventory

configurationParameters.label: Inventoryavailabledate
configurationParameters.description: US inventory available date YYYY-MM-DD for inventory_update. Example: 2026-01-15.

configurationParameters.label: Unit
configurationParameters.description: Inventory unit for inventory_update. Official value: EACH. Nested as quantity.unit. Default EACH.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout seconds (connect + read). <=0 uses api_spec defaultTimeout.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
